lines.text: After some time with the temporary maids, things at the Maid Cafe settle down.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You're not allowed to work today. You're one of our customers.
But there's still a lot of work to do...

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: No no, I won't hear any of it. You sit right here.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: You need some rest as well. I know things have been tough for you,

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: so all you're responsible for today is resting, got it?

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: As any professional maid should be.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: Sounds like Soda needs some help.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: What are you doing sitting here?
Cocoa tells me there's nothing I can help with.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Surely there's something that you could do inside?
She insisted that I rest for the day.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Fine, I guess that's that then.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: So, what would you like me to do,

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: You still think I'm no good at this, don't you?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Well, I won't be making any more mistakes from here on out,

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Well, you'll just have to believe that I said it! Anyway, what would you like?
I'll have the Oh-So-Chewy Devil's Food Cake.
I'll have the Uber Pink Magical Strawberry Crepe.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I'm impressed that you can rattle off these ridiculous names without being embarrassed,

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: but I haven't learned how to make that yet.
Tell me what I can order.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Are you really going to make me say the full name?
How can you call yourself a professional maid if you're too embarrassed to say the full name?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Ugh, why do we have to do this whole song and dance with the food names anyway?
Privaty serves me a plate of omurice.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I'm trying to get through this.
Squirming uncomfortably, Privaty makes a heart with her fingers.
Can you do it one more time?
I think you actually did make it more delicious.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Is that supposed to make me feel better or something?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Well... maybe it does... just a little.
It tastes like undercooked vegetables have been mixed in.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: What was that sound just now? You should spit it out.
It's okay. I think I can eat it.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: There must be something weird in it.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Hurry and give it to me, and I'll make you another.
No, you made this for me, and you even recited the spell.
I could never throw this away.
Privaty watches me with deep concern as I slowly polish off the entire plate of omurice.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: How's your stomach? Are you sure you're okay?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I... I better get back to work.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: You just sit here and relax... or not... do whatever you want.
Privaty picks up the empty plate and leaves.
As I take in my surroundings,
I see Ade looking inside the dining room from the kitchen entrance.
I get up from my seat and walk towards Ade.
What are you doing here alone?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: to see if they were enjoying the Valentine's Day event

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: or if they were uncomfortable or anything.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: It's difficult even looking at their eyes,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: but I figured I needed to start practicing looking from afar.
Are things better than they were before?

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Yesterday, the customers seemed a bit on edge,

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: but today, I think they're enjoying themselves much more.
I look in the direction where Ade is looking.

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: I've got your soft and cuddly omurice right here.

lines.speaker: capmaleguest
lines.text: Drake?! Could I get an autograph?

lines.speaker: drake_m
lines.text: How dare you?! Asking for only one? I'll give you a hundred!

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: You want me to recite the spell?

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: I'm sorry, but that's only for one specific menu item.

lines.speaker: timidfemaleguest
lines.text: Aw, come on! I really want to see it.

lines.speaker: privaty_m
lines.text: Well, if you really want to see it that badly... I'll do it.

lines.speaker: soda
lines.text: but your omurice got a bit burnt...
Soda brings out an omurice that is charred in a few places.

lines.speaker: cocoa
lines.text: I'll cover the charred bits with some ketchup!
Cocoa sprays ketchup on top of the burnt areas.
The customers and the maids all seem to be enjoying themselves reasonably well.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: It doesn't matter that the food isn't perfect, or that the maids fumble a little.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: The customers all seem in high spirits.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: Things are far from perfect, but nobody seems to mind.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: why don't I feel okay about it?
